main_body: Pine-style tree: three lumpy canopy pads on a leaning brown trunk
top_band: Light-to-mid green foliage on the top of the large canopy, rows ~1-6 in the middle column, then darker green down to row ~14
evidence: Each canopy pad has a lit upper surface and a darker underside, and the trunk is a vertical form below. The pads read as volumes seen from above and in front, as the reference trees do. No receding side face is drawn, and it is not a flat elevation or a top-down plan. This is an organic form, so the strict rim and edge-line checks for hard objects do not apply.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 4 greens with some clumping and dither, but the pads are smooth and their silhouettes are simple compared with the leafy, broken edges and per-clump highlights of the references. The trunk is only about 3 browns, with large flat strips and almost no bark grain. The outline is a very dark green around the leaves and a near-black purple around the trunk, which leans toward a sticker look. Tiles carry fewer colours than the reference tiles.
